patientReconciliation.title: URG-TEMP record reconciliation
patientReconciliation.subtitle: Compare the available information, confirm the canonical patient record, and review the complete evidence trail for every decision. No match is applied automatically.
patientReconciliation.queue.title: URG-TEMP records
patientReconciliation.queue.subtitle: Pending records and finalized decisions with access to their evidentiary history.
patientReconciliation.selection.title: Select a record
patientReconciliation.selection.subtitle: Choose an URG-TEMP patient to review candidates, history, and the actions currently allowed.
patientReconciliation.decision.title: Reconciliation decision
patientReconciliation.decision.subtitle: The decision is made by an authorized user, justified, and audited. Historical emergency data remains attached to its original record.
patientReconciliation.decision.type.crea: Keep as a new patient record
patientReconciliation.decision.type.link: Link to an existing patient record
patientReconciliation.decision.evidenceR: Document number, registry entry, or reference
patientReconciliation.decision.justifica: Describe the verified evidence and the reason for this decision.
patientReconciliation.candidates.title: Candidate patient records
patientReconciliation.candidates.warning: Scores support comparison but never constitute an automatic decision.
patientReconciliation.candidates.empty: No similar patient record was found. You may keep this as a new record or defer the decision.
patientReconciliation.terminal.title: This record has a terminal decision
patientReconciliation.terminal.subtitle: A new standard decision is forbidden. Only a secured and audited correction may change an existing link.
patientReconciliation.history.title: Decision history
patientReconciliation.history.subtitle: Every event is retained without alteration, including when a previous decision is corrected.
patientReconciliation.history.empty: No decision has been recorded yet.
patientReconciliation.history.correctsPr: This event corrects a previous decision without deleting it.
patientReconciliation.correction.title: Correct an incorrect patient link
patientReconciliation.correction.subtitl: The correction creates a new evidentiary event. It does not move or delete historical care, documents, or transactions.
patientReconciliation.correction.actionH: Restore the URG-TEMP record as a standalone record or select another canonical patient record.
patientReconciliation.correction.removeL: The URG-TEMP record becomes available for a new human decision.
patientReconciliation.correction.justifi: Describe the identified error, the checks performed, and the selected correction.
patientReconciliation.correction.confirm: I confirm that I verified the identity, the evidence, and the consequences of this correction.
patientReconciliation.success.create_new: The URG-TEMP record has been confirmed as a new patient record.
patientReconciliation.success.link_exist: The URG-TEMP record has been linked to the selected patient record. Its alias and history are preserved.
patientReconciliation.success.defer: The decision has been deferred and recorded in the audit history.
patientReconciliation.success.correct_li: The link has been corrected without moving historical data.
